name: Merafe Resources Limited
source: CRON 20261014: Merafe Resources Limited unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (meraferesources.co.za results booklet), rand thousands. Printed: revenue 3433123, foreign exchange loss (10473), operating and other expenses (2648987), results from operating activities 673244, finance income 28884, finance expense (933), profit before taxation 701195, taxation (189290), total comprehensive income 511905, basic earnings per share 20.5 cents. Operating Expenses is the printed operating and other expenses line and Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed results from operating activities line. Net Finance Costs is negative because the period produced net finance income (finance income 28884 less finance expense 933). Operating profit plus that net finance income equals the printed profit before taxation 701195 exactly, and profit before taxation less taxation equals the printed profit for the period 511905. Merafe prints no gross profit line, so Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are left empty rather than inferred. | source_url: https://www.meraferesources.co.za/results/interims-2026/unaudited-condensed-consolidated-statement-of-profit-or-loss-and-other-comprehensive-income.php
